title: Let the argument set the length
rule: Let the argument determine paragraph length and structure. Do not arbitrarily limit or extend length of text to fit a predefined amount.
example: Use two sentences for a simple result and a longer paragraph for its limitations.
counterexample: Expand every result to exactly five sentences.
rationale: Arbitrary length targets can distort the explanation.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
